scope: Selected EFMW records; not a full corpus audit or executed 23-operation software suite

operations.name: claim extraction
operations.criterion: Complete deduplicated corpus claim inventory
operations.finding: Selected records extracted; no corpus census.

operations.name: source provenance
operations.criterion: All consequential claims linked to immutable source and evidence roots
operations.finding: Selected reports linked; dependency graph incomplete.

operations.name: source independence
operations.criterion: At least one documented outside reproduction for selected benchmark
operations.finding: EXP-003 outside reproduction documented; independence not authenticated anew.

operations.name: citation circularity
operations.criterion: Complete citation DAG checked for circular support
operations.finding: No graph traversal performed.

operations.name: narrative coherence
operations.criterion: Corpus-wide contradictions and claim scope reconciled
operations.finding: Selected papers distinguish evidence levels, not a complete consistency audit.

operations.name: empirical correspondence
operations.criterion: Independent physical observations discriminate EFMW-specific mechanism
operations.finding: Synthetic and formal results do not supply physical confirmation.

operations.name: causal attribution
operations.criterion: Unique EFMW mechanism isolated against matched conventional controls
operations.finding: Signed residual and decay confounded; broad attribution not established.

operations.name: self-fulfillment
operations.criterion: Intervention-induced outcomes separated from predictions
operations.finding: No controlled test.

operations.name: counterfactual evaluation
operations.criterion: Selected negative controls explicitly reported
operations.finding: Known-zero trials and comparator reversal reported.

operations.name: alternative models
operations.criterion: Selected matched conventional comparator explicitly evaluated
operations.finding: Equal-budget PI-plus-lag benchmark reported.

operations.name: consensus independence
operations.criterion: Independent evidence roots distinguished from agent agreement throughout corpus
operations.finding: No corpus-level independence audit.

operations.name: shared errors
operations.criterion: Correlated agent error quantified on held-out cases
operations.finding: No such test executed for this audit.

operations.name: calibration
operations.criterion: Selected known-zero adjusted pipeline meets nominal 5% false-positive target
operations.finding: Reported 9.9%; naive 99.9%. This is a bounded estimator failure.

operations.name: claim production
operations.criterion: Measured consequential claim arrivals per time window
operations.finding: g=12 is illustrative, not observed.

operations.name: verification capacity
operations.criterion: Measured independent resolutions per time window
operations.finding: Simulation parameters are hypothetical.

operations.name: backlog
operations.criterion: Actual deduplicated unresolved claim ledger measured
operations.finding: Toy-model backlog is not an institutional measurement.

operations.name: institutional adoption
operations.criterion: Observed adoption of claims linked to evidentiary status
operations.finding: No decision census.

operations.name: incentive conflicts
operations.criterion: Conflicts recorded and independently reviewed
operations.finding: No governance record examined for this operation.

operations.name: representational dependency
operations.criterion: Dependence on dominant representations measured
operations.finding: Adoption proxy is not a measurement.

operations.name: correction latency
operations.criterion: Time from challenge to documented correction measured
operations.finding: No longitudinal event ledger.

operations.name: independent challenge
operations.criterion: At least one documented external criticism retained in published record
operations.finding: EXP-003 variance-fault reversal and confounding documented.

operations.name: reversal authority
operations.criterion: Independent reviewer authorized to reverse consequential decisions
operations.finding: Authority not established in inspected records.

operations.name: ontological stability
operations.criterion: Calibrated joint backlog, unsupported adoption, divergence and correction failure assessed
operations.finding: Composite index nonspecific; no actual institutional calibration.
